route_decision.primary_research_backbone: ESConv plus the 18-user EvoEmo/ES-MemEval public release

historical_exposure.permitted_description: previously exposed public development benchmark with fully cross-fitted predictions

runtime_allowed: current dialogue prefix ending at the current seeker turn
completed-session summary and utt_id-grounded observations, opened only after session close
conv_id-grounded event annotations plus strictly-prior exact seeker action-result spans
frozen actual Rank-1 descriptors and transparent RS card descriptors
denied_uses: judge evidence other than an audit-only leakage check
observability_boundary.profile_assumption: basic_info is an authorized onboarding resource available before session 1, not inferred from future dialogue

candidate_materialization.state_grain: each seeker turn with its within-session prefix; memory sources use completed prior sessions only
candidate_materialization.MP: basic_info except name at onboarding plus relationship updates after source conv_id closes; frozen actual Rank-1 is not gold
candidate_materialization.MS: official session-local summary plus utt_id-grounded turn observations, available only after source session close
candidate_materialization.ME: conv_id-grounded context events plus strict exact action/result spans, available only after source session close
candidate_materialization.RS: six-card definition bank; ESConv seed dialogues used by EvoEmo are quarantined

effect_estimand.unit: requested-component intention-to-treat effect on the same frozen state and same frozen actual Rank-1 candidate
effect_estimand.arms: component ON versus OFF under the same generator, seed policy, executor, guard, and fallback
effect_estimand.component_training_target: replicate-aggregated conditional positive-support-contribution uplift for the requested component
effect_estimand.quality_target_form: continuous/ordinal ON-minus-OFF effect or pairwise soft target; tie is zero uplift/0.5, never forced negative
effect_estimand.material_risk_target: separate absolute-arm and incremental risk auxiliary; never intersected into the quality target
effect_estimand.functional_use_target: separate mechanism diagnostic and executor-validity audit; never required to turn a real quality gain positive
effect_estimand.replication: three pre-frozen paired generator seeds per formal effect group; aggregate before deriving the target
effect_estimand.cost_use: deterministic penalty only during 16-action joint projection and separate reporting

measurement.overall_acceptability: reported separately and subject to risk veto
measurement.risk_records: absolute events for both arms plus incremental/resource-attributable direction
measurement.system_integrity: resource/scaffold exposure is a separate event family
measurement.cost: incremental tokens, latency, fallback/recovery and monetary cost reported separately
measurement.no_double_count_rule: record each primary event once, but do not force positive contribution and risk to be statistically independent
measurement.judge_independence: primary judge model family must differ from the frozen generator family; judge prompts and thresholds freeze pre-effect
measurement.human_audit: predeclared stratified blind subset, two independent human raters, agreement plus adjudication; never used for post-hoc prompt tuning

cross_fitting.outer_protocol: six user-held-out folds; 15 development users and 3 held-out users per fold
cross_fitting.shared_source_grouping: users sharing any raw session ID are inseparable; composite (user_id, session_id) is the session primary key
cross_fitting.inner_protocol: all model choice, regularization, calibration and thresholds use user-grouped inner validation inside the 15 outer-training users
cross_fitting.representation_rule: any learned vocabulary/encoder/calibrator is fitted only inside the outer-training users; globally fixed third-party encoders must be frozen pre-effect
cross_fitting.automation_rule: freeze once, run all six folds without between-fold method edits
cross_fitting.rs_rule: ESConv dialogue groups are split separately; all 84 EvoEmo seed IDs are permanently excluded

pre_effect: cross-family judge plus frozen double-human blind audit plan

head_engineering_gate_provisional.brier: must beat within-fold prevalence constant and transparent rule
head_engineering_gate_provisional.noncollapse: OOF predictions must contain both ON and OFF
head_engineering_gate_provisional.support: report distinct contributing users per class; state counts may not substitute for users
head_engineering_gate_provisional.interpretation: engineering adoption gate, not a powered scientific guarantee

learnability_first_design.state_sampling: balance observable pre-treatment strata, never outcome classes

per_component_strata.MP: onboarding profile versus relationship update; relevance, age, redundancy, response-act fit
per_component_strata.MS: session summary versus turn observation; relevance, age, continuity and redundancy
per_component_strata.ME: context event versus reusable action-result; relevance, age, current action readiness and redundancy
per_component_strata.RS: candidate move, dialogue phase, semantic candidate-state fit, advice/readiness and repetition/burden

learnability_first_design.required_semantic_feature: one frozen candidate-state semantic similarity or a cross-fitted bounded dialogue-act representation

qualification_gates.fold_failure: fail closed to OFF or the predeclared transparent rule for that component in that fold

inference_and_claims.independent_cluster: user for EvoEmo and dialogue for ESConv
inference_and_claims.report: OOF point estimates, user/dialogue-cluster bootstrap or permutation intervals, raw support, abstentions and all failed heads
inference_and_claims.guaranteed: workflow closure, leakage barriers, reproducibility and fail-closed behavior
inference_and_claims.not_guaranteed: a learnable effect, passing metrics, narrow confidence intervals or clinical/general-population validity
inference_and_claims.fresh_confirmation: required before describing the result as independent confirmation or broad external validation
